title: The UAE says Iran resumes attacks as the U.S. moves to reopen the Strait of Hormuz
summary: The U.S. military said it helped two merchant ships transit the Strait of Hormuz, and the United Arab Emirates said it was fending off Iranian missiles and drones.
contentText:
The U.S. military said it battled Iranian forces and sank six small boats as it moved to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, while the United Arab Emirates said Iran fired missiles and drones its way.

(Image credit: Amirhosein Khorgooi)
